content.text: Published under /docs/rate-limits; redirect from the old FAQ blurb is live.
Public docs mention rate limits only in passing and omit header names, window length, and per-route cost multipliers. Partners reverse-engineer behavior from 429 bodies.

Complete when the developer portal has a dedicated page covering free/pro/enterprise hourly tiers, RateLimit-* headers, 429 JSON shape, Retry-After behavior, and cost weights for search vs write routes, reviewed by DX and linked from the API reference.
